scores.label: Needs work
notes: Sample report: Cedar & Core is a made-up studio used to test the report page.

findings.summary: Cedar & Core's site looks good and explains the classes clearly, but it loads slowly on phones and never says Burbank where Google looks for it. Fixing speed and local signals first would do the most for new bookings.

items.title: The homepage takes almost 5 seconds to show its main image on a phone
items.what_we_found: Google's speed test measured a Largest Contentful Paint (the moment the biggest thing on screen appears) of 4.8 seconds on mobile. The hero photo is a 3.1 MB file.
items.why_it_matters: Most people looking for a class nearby are on their phone, and many leave a page that is still blank after three seconds.
items.fix: Serve the hero photo at the size phones actually need.

items.title: Burbank doesn't appear in the title, main heading or opening paragraph
items.what_we_found: The homepage title is "Cedar & Core | Pilates and Strength" and the main heading is "Move better, every day". Neither mentions Burbank.
items.why_it_matters: People search for "pilates Burbank". Google leans on the title and main heading to decide which local studios match.
items.fix: Name the city where Google and visitors look first.

items.title: The phone number can't be tapped to call
items.what_we_found: The number (818) 555-0142 appears in the footer as plain text on all 6 pages we checked.
items.why_it_matters: A visitor on a phone has to copy the number by hand, and some won't bother.
items.fix: Make the phone number a tap-to-call link.

items.title: Two pages share the same title
items.what_we_found: /classes and /schedule are both titled "Cedar & Core | Pilates and Strength".
items.why_it_matters: Matching titles make it harder for Google to tell the pages apart and show the right one.
items.fix: Give each page a title that says what's on it.

items.title: No business details for Google in the code
items.what_we_found: We found no structured data (the hidden labels that tell Google your name, address, phone and hours).
items.why_it_matters: Without it, Google has to guess your hours and address, and the map listing can drift from your site.
items.fix: Add structured data that matches your Google listing.

top_three: Speed up the homepage on phones by right-sizing the hero photo.
Put Burbank in the homepage title and main heading.
Make the phone number tap-to-call on every page.
